SELECT ipr.target_category, ipr.target_type, ipr.plan_id, ipr.target_id, ipr.standard_id, is2.NAME AS standard_name, ipr.item_id, isi.alias AS item_name, isi.NAME AS itemContent, ir.item_name AS defaultResult,
GROUP_CONCAT(ir2.item_name SEPARATOR ',') AS resultNames
STRING_AGG(ir2.item_name, ',') AS resultNames
LISTAGG(ir2.item_name, ',') AS resultNames
GROUP_CONCAT(ir2.item_name SEPARATOR ',') AS resultNames
FROM inspect_plan_relation ipr LEFT JOIN inspect_standard is2 ON ( is2.id = ipr.standard_id ) LEFT JOIN inspect_standard_item isi ON ( isi.id = ipr.item_id ) LEFT JOIN inspect_result ir ON ( ir.id = isi.result_id AND isi.result_item_value = ir.item_value ) LEFT JOIN inspect_result ir2 ON ( ir2.id = isi.result_id ) GROUP BY ipr.standard_id, is2.NAME, ipr.item_id, ir.NAME, isi.NAME

SELECT ipr.target_category, ipr.target_type, ipr.plan_id, ipr.target_id, ipr.standard_id, is2.NAME AS standard_name, ipr.item_id, iit.alias AS item_name, iit.NAME AS itemContent, ir.item_name AS defaultResult,
GROUP_CONCAT(ir2.item_name SEPARATOR ',') AS resultNames
STRING_AGG(ir2.item_name, ',') AS resultNames
LISTAGG(ir2.item_name, ',') AS resultNames
GROUP_CONCAT(ir2.item_name SEPARATOR ',') AS resultNames
FROM inspect_plan_relation ipr LEFT JOIN inspect_standard is2 ON ( is2.id = ipr.standard_id ) LEFT JOIN inspect_item_template iit ON ( iit.id = ipr.item_id ) LEFT JOIN inspect_result ir ON ( ir.id = iit.result_id AND iit.result_item_value = ir.item_value ) LEFT JOIN inspect_result ir2 ON ( ir2.id = iit.result_id ) where ipr.is_raw_item = 1 and ipr.plan_id = #{plainId}
and ipr.target_id = #{targetId}
GROUP BY ipr.standard_id, is2.NAME, ipr.item_id, ir.NAME, iit.NAME
